items.headline: O adds AI safety official to its board
items.summary: O is adding Paul Christiano to the boards of both O and its nonprofit, with a role on the safety/security committee. Signal: reinforcement of governance around alignment as capabilities advance.

items.headline: O expands policy team amid legislative headwinds
items.summary: Axios reports three hires to grow O’s global affairs/policy work across state policy and partnerships. This suggests nearer-term responsiveness to accelerating AI regulation and compliance demands.

items.headline: O releases GPT-6 Astra in ChatGPT
items.summary: O’s ChatGPT release notes include “Introducing GPT-6 Astra.” Rollout also updates Voice model/limits, indicating ongoing product iteration and potential demand/usage growth via improved capability.
